Each row independently classified this round -- KNOWN_OPEN and NEW required no trust of prior reports; RESOLVED_VERIFIED required a fresh check (test run, grep, or independent recompute) performed this round, not a re-read of a remediation report's own claim; RESOLVED_UNVERIFIED means a code change was confirmed but the specific outcome claim (e.g. '0 collisions') was not independently re-run.

top_critical_findings: P0-1 (STILL OPEN, unchanged): No point-in-time universe exists anywhere in the codebase; every backtest and factor-IC test still runs on today's listed 500-symbol universe projected backward to 2020. Re-confirmed this round via fresh grep (check_survivorship_bias has zero call sites) and a live query of the partial-mitigation trading_status.py table (462 ACTIVE / 19 STALE_SHORT / 20 INACTIVE_LONG), which is explicitly documented as not a substitute for a real point-in-time universe.

RESOLVED, independently re-verified this round: Gate #6 (stale data). build_portfolio_stack.py now reads via src/data/dataset_config.py's OFFICIAL_FEATURES_PATH; tests/test_dataset_config.py (6 tests) re-run fresh this round, all pass.

RESOLVED, independently re-verified this round with the strongest evidence produced in this audit: Gate #12 (reproducibility). An independent recompute of the committed portfolio_risk_report.json's return matrix, using the exact documented method and the report's own stated cutoff, reproduced the exact row count (1626=1626) and all 4 headline metrics (annual_return, annual_volatility, sharpe_ratio, max_drawdown) to 1e-9 -- versus round 1's 1621-vs-1317-row mismatch and 0/3 metrics matching.

RESOLVED, independently re-verified this round: Gate #17 (unvalidated model reported as validated). alpha_rs_score confirmed removed from relative_strength_score via direct code read and 3 fresh regression-test runs; the live final_watchlist.parquet artifact was inspected directly and contains zero shadow-field columns. The broader pattern is now structurally prevented: final_watchlist.py no longer claims to rank by alpha at all (Nhánh C, a pre-registered, validated-negative research conclusion honestly reflected in production behavior).

NEW finding this round: portfolio_return_series (src/risk/management.py) silently treats a symbol's no-trade day as a 0% return (fillna(0.0)) rather than excluding it from volatility/covariance calculation -- surfaced during this round's independent Phase D math validation when a naive w^T Sigma w recompute did not match the committed report until this convention was matched exactly. For the current sample portfolio, 3/10 symbols have 12-15% NaN-day rates. Not a bug (internally consistent once the convention is known), but undocumented and could understate realized volatility for thinly-traded names.
recommended_next_phase: Do not proceed to a real-capital pilot -- Gate #3 (survivorship bias) remains the sole blocking critical failure, unchanged from round 1 despite the overall score rising from 58 to 78. The highest-leverage next phase is acquiring or constructing a point-in-time delisting/suspension data source (the single largest remaining item in the entire audit). Secondary items (Ledoit-Wolf shrinkage, transaction-cost decomposition, Monte Carlo seeding, board-lot enforcement, portfolio-construction-parameter holdout separation) are real but do not block production-readiness the way Gate #3 does. Shadow/paper-trading operation (alpha_score v2, alpha_score_shadow_v1) may reasonably continue in parallel, as it commits no capital.
